page.overview:
Who is Chud?

They have a sickly pale complexion, blue tongue, slit nose, sharp teeth and no eyes. Upon observing their facial structure, we can see that they may have at one point had eyes. They have little hair and large ears, and all are skeletal. They all wear torn clothes of some sort; some only wearing pants and others are fully clothed. All appear to be male and fairly old.
